# Lightweight regional fallback monthly pulse for Red Sea / Holy Land / Ethiopia & Trajan's Canal (slot 53).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 53 has already run this month, oe_red_ran_m == oe_red_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Keeps the line alive if BYZ falls or before slot 53 is registered in gen_mainline_lock.py.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_red_fallback_pulse } }

oe_red_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        NOT = { global_var:oe_red_ran_m ?= oe_red_m_now }
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            oe_red_human_fallback_eligible = yes
            tag = ROM
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM } NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = MAM }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM } NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:MAM } tag = ETH }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_red_monthly = yes
    }
}
